text_block_list.text:
After school, Marvelous Sunday and Nice 
Nature were chatting.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is this... you and Mayano? "The duo 
who made the extinct phantom flower 
bloom"— you're literally all over the 
news, you know?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah, maybe that's from the other day? They 
praised us a whole bunch~☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No matter how you look at it, that's the 
discovery of the century... Shouldn't you 
brag about it a bit more?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I just helped marvelous happen☆ It was 
when we happened to be playing in the 
snowy mountains, you see—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Take this☆ Kaiser Ball★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! You're gonna get it~! Mayano has one 
too... Powerful Ball~~♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeek! So coldddd☆ All right, I'm gonna 
make an even bigger snowball~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eek☆ Save me, save me~! Ahahahaha♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: What's wrong? Giving up already?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Mayano! Let's make a snow hut 
right here!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
A snow hut?! Let's do it, let's do it! 
Let's build a grand one like a castle!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Done! A marvelous snow hut☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: All right, let's go inside right away and—
Ugaaah guguuu... Gugaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah-wah?! A-A gorilla? A pure 
white gorilla...!

text_block_list.name: White Gorilla?
text_block_list.text: Grrrrroooaaargh!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Are you angry?! M-Maya and her friend 
didn't do anything bad~~!!

text_block_list.name: White Gorilla?
text_block_list.text: Ugogooo... Gafururu...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I see.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You were protecting this place, weren't 
you? All by yourself, for a long, long 
time.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Believing that someday, a "wish"... that a 
marvelous day would come.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! This warm snow hut will envelop 
it all in marvelous!

text_block_list.name: White Gorilla?
text_block_list.text: Fuguuu... Garuruuu...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I-It left...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—And that's what happened☆ After that, a 
marvelous flower bloomed, so I told 
everyone about it★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! There are way too many things 
wrong with that story!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
A mysterious white gorilla? Snow hut 
power? The scale is just way too absurd... 
Haha, ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The wish was heard and a miraculous 
marvelous was born☆ Isn't that wonderful♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, let's go look at the marvelous 
flower! Let me show you the wa~y☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Show you the way☆"? Wait, when was it 
decided that I was coming along?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahahahaha☆ Wait for us, 
marvelouuuus★☆★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous, huh... I wonder if wishing from 
the bottom of my heart would give me some 
miraculous power-up too.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Of course☆ First, you just have to start 
by feeling all the marvelous overflowing 
in the world~★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Actually, sorry, forget I said 
anything. I'm scared I'll stop being 
myself...
